visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Rotating by More Than the Length
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Rotating a 5-item array by 7 is the same as rotating by 2 and should print [3,4,5,1,2], but the array comes back unchanged.

solution.explanation: After a full turn (5 steps) the array looks the same again, so only k modulo the length matters. Without the modulo, slice(7) is empty and slice(0, 7) is the whole array.
